title: Minecraft Iron Farm Tutorial - NEW DESIGN - 1700~10000 P/HR! 1.20.6
description:
Hello Guys TheySix Is here with a New Video, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make an Extremely Fast and Efficient Iron Farm but very simple to build In Minecraft 1.20.6

📚This iron farm will produce +1700 by each layer you can increase this rate by adding more layers to the farm
📚This is a new design for the iron farm its compact and very easy to build
📚In this design, i used the easiest type of room for villagers to make the farm so simple and i used a new type of mechanic for zombies and which will cause a 30s delay
📚You can build this farm in 20 - 60 mins and it's so simple ( recommended for beginners )
📚also, you can add more layers to the farm, for this just go up 16 blocks from the villagers
📚You can also build this farm anywhere you want in the air or ocean, except for frozen biomes.

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
